baseline: Sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology on the same o sequence (the CALIB-01 baseline, recomputed on fresh-seed data).
conditions: changing_rule v1.0.0, arch_b, affect='none', action_mode default (as in CALIB-01), 10 episodes x 5 fresh seeds {73601,73602,73603,73604,73605}, PredictionLog JSONL per seed, pooled in seed order (73601..73605, tick order) = 1950 ticks/domain. Estimator runs over the pooled stream with NO reset at seed boundaries (same information structure as the sequential-climatology baseline). Deterministic; stdlib only.

config.protocol: 1950-tick CALIB-01 protocol (5 fresh seeds x 10 eps, changing_rule v1.0.0, arch_b, affect=none)

hypothesis: A rolling-window empirical event rate (W=200, Laplace-smoothed) beats sequential climatology on >=3/4 calibration domains: Brier_roll < Brier_climo.
interpretation: REJECTED. Rolling-window (W=200) empirical rate beats climatology on 2/4 domains (D2 +0.002, D4 +0.003; D1/D3 fail) — below the preregistered >=3/4 bar. The W=50 ablation beats on 1/4 (D4 CALIBRATED). Recency carries almost no information beyond the running average on this stream: the event rates are too stable for windowing to help. Full NR entry.
limitations: Single env (changing_rule); the window's edge, if any, comes from adapting to flip-induced nonstationarity.; Pooled-stream estimator sees seed-boundary discontinuities (same order as baseline).; affect='none' matches CALIB-01.
null_hypothesis: Brier_roll >= Brier_climo on >=2/4 domains (fails the >=3/4 bar): recency carries no probabilistic information beyond the running base rate.
preregistered_metric: Per-domain Brier_roll vs Brier_climo (sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology), scored by benchmarks/calibration_battery.py score_domain on the pooled tick stream. PASS iff Brier_roll < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains. A domain scoring UNMEASURABLE under CALIB-01's gates counts as not-beaten. corr(sigma,|err|) reported per domain (Pearson, pooled scored ticks); no threshold (supplementary, per program step 1).
